description: This file defines the LikeFunction class which implements a filter function comparing strings with simple wildcard pattern matching, used within the Eclipse Ditto project for placeholder filtering logic.

classes.name: LikeFunction
classes.description: A final class implementing FilterFunction to perform pattern matching with wildcard support.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function, which is 'like'.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the 'like' filter by matching the first parameter against a pattern generated from the second parameter, supporting '*' and '?' wildcards.

methods.name: toJavaRegex
methods.description: Converts a wildcard pattern string into a Java regular expression, escaping special characters and translating wildcards.
